scheme_name: Credit Enhancement Guarantee Scheme For The Scheduled Castes
other_conditions: Borrower must have more than 51% shareholding by Scheduled Caste promoters for the past 6 months with management control
Applicable to enterprises in primary, manufacturing, or services sectors
Enterprise must be set up, promoted, and run by Scheduled Castes and may be under any State/Central Government subsidy or grant scheme
Shareholding by Scheduled Caste promoters must not be diluted below 51% during the loan period
Guarantee cover lock‑in period of 12 months from the date of last disbursement
benefits_summary: Provides a credit guarantee of Rs.0.15–5 crore (up to Rs.1 crore for individual SC entrepreneurs) for loans up to a maximum of 7 years.
documents_required: Documentary proof of Scheduled Caste status (caste certificate)
Copy of valid sanction letter or Letter of Intent issued to the SC beneficiary
